args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods): Highlights retail returns logistics as this week's topic, linking to a deeper-dive article.
- Linked article: Apparel return rates have reached 24%; consolidating returns into dedicated handling hubs cut processing costs by about 20%.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their original margin, underscoring the value of fast turnaround in returns processing.
